name: Academic Content & Assessment Excellence

reading.method: Power Lab challenge submission requires an answer, exact passage quote for normal answers, and reason. NOT GIVEN requires an absence rationale and no external knowledge.

listening.method: Power Lab challenge submission requires the day MP3 to be played and a phrase that matches the scripted source. Audio is synthetic original IELTS Boost practice, not official IELTS audio.

vocabulary.local_curator: Definition source URL/title and a separate CEFR sense-level source URL; local learner-reviewed override with JSON import/export.
vocabulary.cefr_policy: Inherited levels remain estimates; a learner must check and record a sense-level source before assigning a verified CEFR label.

quality_policy: No automatic IELTS examiner band is generated. Local 0–10 values are practice metrics. Official IELTS descriptors are paraphrased as guidance and linked to rights holders; no protected tests, audio or publisher text were copied.
